decisions.reason: The low-pressure injection pump remains very close to the firm's core machinery range, so a medium-sized German equipment maker would usually keep this option open while incremental market evidence continues to build.
As a product line with several models built on established capabilities, the low-pressure material transfer pump has strong fit and low marginal carrying cost, making withdrawal unlikely.

Fire protection flow monitoring is more adjacent and its commercial value is still less proven, but it supports the firm's digitalization direction, so the option is still worth preserving for another year.
The hydraulic two-component spraying system is newly launched and close to the established offer, so management would typically allow more time to learn about demand before considering abandonment.
